author: Carlos Martinez
title: iRacing Hockenheim: Mazda MX-5 From P20 to P14
description: Clips from my iRacing Mazda MX-5 race at Hockenheim. I started P20 and finished P14. This is a racing simulator, not real life.

sections.p: This is iRacing, a racing simulator. It is not real life. These clips come from a Mazda MX-5 race at Hockenheim.
I raced live on my stream. I started P20 and finished P14. Here are the clips from that race.

list: P20 to P17 in the opening laps, three spots gained.
P17 to P14 in twelve seconds, in traffic.
P14 to P12, the highest I ran all race.
The race ended with a finish in P14, after a start in P20.

sections.p: The Hockenheimring is in Germany. One lap is 4.574 km. More sim racing guides are on the blog.

faqs.a: No. This is iRacing, a racing simulator. The race was in a Mazda MX-5 at Hockenheim.

faqs.q: Where did you start and finish?
faqs.a: I started P20 and finished P14. The highest I ran during the race was P12.

faqs.q: How long is a lap at the Hockenheimring?
faqs.a: One lap is 4.574 km. The Hockenheimring is in Germany.
